scope: Finite native Vulkan original Standard-material comparison at six retained consumer rest transforms. Close orthographic views only. Original pixels and mesh arrays remain private.

source.alpha_semantics: Cutout coverage at the retained Standard cutoff, not blended translucency.

fixture.png_encoding: Linear HDR readback, RGB clamped to [0,1], then sRGB encoded. No tone mapping.

measurement_definitions.verification: PNG hashes, dimensions and persistent per-frame metrics independently match each final report. Linear measurements are retained from native readback; they cannot be recomputed from the clamped PNG.
measurement_definitions.occupiedPixels: Summed absolute RGB difference > 0.003 from the matched background-only capture.
measurement_definitions.overOnePixels: Any linear RGB component > 1 before PNG encoding. These samples are clamped in PNG.
measurement_definitions.changedFromOriginalPixels: Summed absolute RGB difference > 0.003 from matched original material.
measurement_definitions.capture_pass: No nonfinite pixels, fewer than 64 magenta pixels and at least 64 occupied pixels; replacements must change at least one pixel. Highlight clipping is measured but does not fail this technical check.

native_visual_review.findings: Both heads, all five serrated leaf surfaces and both stems retain their intended atlas regions. The owned leaf veins and lobes remain continuous in front and rear views. The upper head keeps the original planar card tilt and appears flat when nearly edge-on. Yellow petal groups, green leaf values and continuous stems remain recognizable; the rear is darker under the fixed light arrangement. HD and Balanced retain the same layout. Front petal highlights clip during PNG encoding, limiting final color interpretation. No native distance or fractional-LOD conclusion follows from these close orthographic views.

limitations.close_view: Orthographic size 0.5 gives a one-unit vertical span. Camera distance does not establish distant appearance. All frames show a close view of one isolated retained mesh.
limitations.mips: Passing head-region texel centers remain through 8px. The 4px and 2px diagnostics lose head coverage; the 1px tail is transparent. No fractional LOD or native distance transition is established here.
limitations.highlight_clamp: Native linear RGB above one is recorded for each frame. Encoded PNG clamps those highlights without tone mapping, limiting final color and material interpretation.
limitations.world: No ground contact, placed-world integration, weather, animation, gameplay readability, runtime deployment or representative hardware performance is established.
limitations.ownership: Original geometry, UVs, normals, tangents and all native captures remain private. Albedo-only comparisons preserve the original null normal binding.
limitations.approval: CPU layout review, native payload validation and finite native material checks are separate from world validation and final art approval.
